details.review: The overview exposes the crank and upper pin. The front shows both guide sleeves, vertical slot, input, output and the four alternatives. Independent PNG-only reader: A CW drives B and the keyed crank CCW. At the top the pin travels left, taking the horizontal yoke left. Selected C.
